_comment: Popup motion of Windows 11 (26100) measured on reference-shots/motion/*: QMP screendumps every 17-38 ms with
real timestamps (times.json). The VM has no GPU and screendump is not vsync'd: Windows presents every second
capture or so and sometimes stalls (notifications f41-f47), so each observation is an interval
(previous distinct capture, capture]. Offsets are measured on the panel's top edge (left edge for the right
panels) against f000 in the panel's columns (tools: tests/visual/motion.py frames + an edge scan); the fits
are least squares of offset(t) = travel * (1 - bezier((t - t0) / duration)) over those intervals, with the
travel fixed at 'fully hidden' (the panel starts just behind the taskbar / screen edge, see 'start').
Values used by the shell: shell/qml/design/Motion.qml. Kinds without frames say 'assumption'.

start.clip: bottom edge 1032 (taskbar top) while moving: slides out from behind the taskbar
start.fill: panel fill 36,36,36 from the first visible frame (= final): no fade; tiles and recommendations already drawn: no stagger

quick.clip: bottom edge 1030-1027 while moving (taskbar top 1032), 1020 when settled
quick.fill: 36,36,36 in every frame: no fade, no stagger

notifications.frames: notifications-open f034 (558.6, nothing) f035 572.3 f038 618.9 f040 648.1 f041 663.3 (stalls to f047) f048 768.0 f051 815.5 (final)
notifications.note: notifications and calendar cards move together, in from the right screen edge (clipped by it)
notifications.fill: 28,28,28 in every frame: no fade, no stagger

search.frames: search-open f030 (611.8, nothing) f031 627.7 f034 702.7 (final); results drawn at f048 (3096 ms, web content)
search.note: f001-f030 only show the search box hover. The first frame Windows presents is already 19 px from the end; with the Start curve that is the tail of the same full-height slide (the search host presents late). Treated as the Start motion.

fits.method: /tmp fit script (numpy grid over curve, duration 80-700 ms, t0); rms in px over the observation intervals
fits.conclusion: bottom panels: cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1) 250 ms (start 0.8 px, quick 3.4 px rms); right panels: cubic-bezier(0.33,0,0.1,1) 220 ms (4.3 px rms). The old (0.1,0.9,0.2,1) is 3-6x worse on quick/notifications.

taskbar.what: Start, Search, Quick settings (+ media card), tray overflow, jump lists, taskbar and tray menus
taskbar.travel: panel height + gap to the taskbar (starts fully hidden behind the taskbar's top edge, clipped there)

close.source: measured (observations_close_2026_11_07): Start 150, Search 170, Quick settings 160 ms

edge.travel: panel width + its margin to the right edge (starts off screen)

menu.what: Start power / account / app menus, desktop context menu
menu.source: assumption: no frames. WinUI MenuFlyout (MenuPopupThemeTransition): reveals from half its height on the open curve, quick fade-in; closes with a quick fade
menu.travel: 50 % of the menu height, clipped at its anchored edge

fade.source: assumption: no frames; WinUI fast fade (167 ms in on the open curve, 83 ms out)

osd.source: assumption: no OSD frames (no media keys in the VM); taskbar pattern: rises from behind the taskbar's top edge

page.what: Start Pinned <-> All apps, Quick settings subpages
page.source: assumption: no frames; WinUI EntranceThemeTransition (40 px horizontal offset) on the open curve with a fade

used.task_view: Task view is KWin's Overview effect, not a shell popup: not changed here

fenestra_bench.how: MOTION=1 tests/shell-kwin/build.sh (motion.py: GrabScopes frames 14-54 ms apart, software renderer, 2026-11-07)

_comment: QMP screendumps every 7-20 ms (tests/vm/qmp.py through a recorder that sends the key or click between dumps), VM
~/VMs/win11-ref booted on 2026-11-07: Windows had updated to the 2025 Start (one scrolling page, 832 x 866; Search as tall),
so the Start/Search travel here is 878 px (panel top 154). Quick settings (top 685, travel 347) and Notification Center
(left 1572, travel 348) are the 26100 ones. Open with Win / click on the box / Win+A / Win+N, close with Win or Esc.
Per recording: [ms since the first dump, moving edge (top; left for notifications), null = nothing of the panel in the band];
repeated frames dropped. Every close slides back the way it came, fully opaque, clipped by the taskbar / screen edge: no fade.
Fits (bench/fit.py: least squares, start time free, travel fixed): close accel-mid (0.7,0,1,0.5) Start 150 ms (rms 34 px on an
878 px travel at ~10 px/ms, i.e. the dump jitter), Search 170 ms (29), Quick settings 160 ms (11.5), Notification Center 140 ms
(11.5); accel (1,0,1,1) is as good, decelerating curves 3x worse. Opening on the same recordings: Quick settings (0,0,0,1)
250 ms (9.1 px), Notification Center (0.33,0,0.1,1) 180-220 ms (9.8 px): the values in 'used' stand.
Taskbar buttons (same VM, light theme): the hover plate fades in and out in ~90 ms (dump steps 150/176/203/230 ms after a
~100 ms input lag); pressing fades it to the pressed fill in ~100 ms and shrinks the icon over ~150 ms.
